newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle fairly active at $69 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle fairly active at $69 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was fairly active, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers $2.00 per cwt higher than last week. Inquiry good, demand fairly good.

Sales confirmed on 14,100 slaughter steers and 13,400 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 31,300 head confirmed including 4,600 head or about 15 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.

Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1300 lbs, mostly 1150-1200 lbs 69.00, few Select with end Choice including cutting bulls 68.50-69.00; pen Select and Choice 1200 lb Holsteins 62.00. Dressed basis - Select and Choice 1150-1200 lbs 111.00-112.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 980-1100 lbs 69.00, pen 950 lbs 68.00; few mixed Commerical to Choice 1100-1250 lb heifers and heiferettes 68.50-69.00.
Wk to date - 31,300 week ago - 30,500 year ago - 26,000
